The provided API for variant coordinate conversion (llg_001) and the use of protein annotation tools for translation (llg_002) are both essential and correctly scoped. No unsupported or misleading LLGs were identified, and there are no missing essential capabilities.

The parent HLG is fully covered by the LLGs, with llg_001 focusing on the API for variant coordinate conversion and llg_002 addressing the translation into protein-level impacts. Both LLGs adhere to the document-supported automatic effects criterion, as they do not require manual triggers from the researcher actor.

There is no need for regeneration or correction in this case; the current LLGs are complete, supported, and non-redundant.
